_설명: 천일문 2권 Chapter 12 관계대명사에서 가져와 변형한 문항. 은행에서는 기본 8과 관계사 자리에 합쳐 둔다.

points.point: that은 사람·사물 모두에 쓸 수 있다
목적격 관계대명사: 뒤에 주어+동사가 오고 생략할 수 있다
관계대명사절 안에 대명사를 겹쳐 쓰지 않는다
주격 관계대명사절의 동사는 선행사에 수를 맞춘다

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 알맞지 않은 것을 고르세요.

My aunt is a teacher [[which]] teaches music.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 두 문장을 한 문장으로 잘못 연결한 것을 고르세요.

choices.text: I met a man. His voice was very deep. → I met a man whose voice was very deep.
Tigers are animals. They can run so fast. → Tigers are animals that can run so fast.
Did you read the letter? I sent it to you. → Did you read the letter which I sent to you?
She didn’t understand the thing. I said the thing. → She didn’t understand which I said.
Look at the dog. It’s running after a ball. → Look at the dog which is running after a ball.
